Indulge in the huge selection of high quality melt-in-your-mouth Wagyu cuts, sashimi and other Japanese delicacies, available for both ala carte and buffet style, behold the gastronomic experience you would never forget. Its smokeless grill also provides a healthier and more environmentally-friendly BBQ experience.

Visit www.thelittlegym.com.sg for details. For decades, The Little Gym has helped children between 4 months and 12 years develop motor skills in a fun, supportive environment. Research and hands-on experience have taught that teaching motor skills to kids helps them build confidence to do their best at home, at play and in the classroom. The Little Gym's classes are guided by a professionally developed curriculum to help students grow one somersault at a time. Book your trial class today!

The maternity brand has been making pregnant women look good for over a decade. It offers flattering - and more importantly, comfortable - clothing made of fabrics such as chiffon, silk and lycra by an awardwinning local designer. The price range will also make mums-to-be smile - tops go for between $20 to $60, while dress prices start from $69.90. With new stuff brought in every month, expectant mums have no reason to shun shopping!

The Par Club Singapore aims to bring golf to all, regardless of experience. Spanning across an area of 4,909 square feet, our space features state of the art indoor golf technology from Foresight Sports, highly experienced coaching professionals as well as a custom putting green designed to meet your every need. On top of that, be spoilt for choice with specially curated food, alcohol and drinks that are sure to satisfy the inner foodie in you. Bring your friends and family! Because at The Par Club Singapore, you can truly unwind, play and enjoy the game of golf.

No matter where you're headed, this sprawling 5000 square feet flagship store has everything you need for the trans-global journey. The widest range of travel bags, books and maps, plus travel accessories, appliances, games and gifts await you at this travel megastore. Besides exclusive shelf space for Victorinox - the makers of the original Swiss Army Knife you'll also find world-renowned travel names like Hartmann, Mandarina Duck, Eagle Creek, Egon, Klean Kanteen, Mova Globes, Crossing, Tatonka, Vaude, Caribee, BREE, Briggs & Riley, Troika, B+D Reader, Golla, Nova Rico, Wild and Wolf and The North Face among others.

The Toy Folks is an independent book and toy store in Singapore specialising in quality and curated arts and crafts, educational toys, books and games for kids 0 – 12 years of age. Established in 2016, we're proud to bring the best of books and toys that enrich children’s lives and add lasting value to building children’s foundations
The Tree Cafe is a halal cafe brand with a self-service concept, with an affordable cafe experience and a wide range of Western and Asian-fusion inspired menu.
Founded by two brothers, The Vermilion House offers a modern take on Mediterranean cuisine paired alongside award-winning Italian wines, bringing unique flavours to the heart of downtown Singapore.

THREEPPY is a new concept store operated by DAISO Japan since 2018. You can ﬁnd a variety of cute and fashionable items. With our wide variety of products, we brighten our customers’ lives with good quality and affordable products from Japan. Happy Price, Happy Place, Happy People.

Visit Timezone website for details. Timezone is the world's leading fun family interactive entertainment centre with state-of-the-art games and a wide variety of attractive prizes. Timezone games come from world-class amusement brands such as Sega, Banda Namco and LAI to name a few. Our best-in-class store design and well trained FunSquad guarantees a fun-filled experience for both the young and the young-at-heart.
TRT, a Singaporean label, offers sustainable, modular fashion for men, women, and kids, focusing on timeless, versatile designs and creative self-expression.

Turtle is an innovative novelty gift and lifestyle shop. One can find a range of unique and quirky stationery, plushies, onesies, toys, gadgets, party supplies, beauty products, home decorations and lifestyle indulgences here at our Marina Square Outlet!

urban de.Fine sources for the most unique and high quality executive lifestyle products within and out of The Little Red Dot. Each brand's emergence has a story behind and urban de.Fine aims to bring our customers inspirations and motivations from these brand owners. urban de.Fine is a multi-label concept store that defines your individuality.

A premium Hong Kong-inspired bakery which marries elements of a classic Hong Kong tea house with modern touches through the use of premium ingredients. Victoria Bakery’s pastries are made using traditional baking techniques and updated with modern and innovative flavours, boasting a laid-back atmosphere where customers are able to enjoy light bites, freshly baked goods and freshly-ground artisanal coffee.

At Vincitore, their collection of handmade shoes embodies the fine craftmanship of master Italian shoemakers. Each exquisite pair of shoes espouses the intricacy of meticulous Italian craftsmanship, elaborately designed to augment your polished wardrobe.
A perfectly & indulgence sleep

VroomTown features multiple Singapore icons including the Merlion, Gardens by the Bay and Changi Airport! The realistic driving experience also includes traffic lights & signs, a playground and a drive-through for kids!

Home-grown vision care centre providing eyecare solutions, optical products, such as prescriptive lenses, night lenses, contact lenses, and eye examinations catering to specific needs of customers. Eye examinations are tailored to individual needs by age group, necessary for all in this digital age to screen for different eye conditions or eye diseases. Specialize in Myopia management in children. W OPTICS at Marina Sqaure is a Myopia Centre.

Singapore’s Leading Health & Beauty Retailer - Watsons is Asia’s No. 1 Personal Care and Beauty Offline + Online Retailer, with close to 100 stores islandwide and the flagship health and beauty brand of the A.S. Watson Group. It continually sets the standard in heath, wellness, and beauty by providing personalized and related advice and counselling to customers and a market-leading product range in their offering, so that they can ‘LOOK GOOD, DO GOOD, FEEL GREAT’ every day. Other accolades and awards received include Omnichannel Strategy of the Year 2023 – Singapore and Health & Beauty Retailer of the Year – Singapore consecutively from 2021 – 2023 by Retail Asia Awards and ‘Best HR Digital Transformation Strategy’ at the prestigious Employee Experience Awards 2023. Watsons accepts NETS, DBS PAYLAH!, VISA, MASTERCARD, AMERICAN EXPRESS, JCB, DINERS CLUB INTERNATIONAL, UNIONPAY.

West Coast Dental Clinic provides family dentistry in a clean, pleasant, and relaxing environment. Fully equipped to render a full range of dental services including braces, root canal, wisdom tooth and dental implants. Medisave claimable. Dr. Arthur Lim is friendly, gentle and has more than 20 years of experience in treating patients from many different countries.

XTRA is a premium design store in Singapore founded since 1989. Originally sited in a pre-war conservation shophouse in the east, we started as an alternative eclectic design store but have since evolved into a mainstream store with a carefully curated range of global design products for both the residential and contract market.

As a separate independent entity, XTRA OFFICE is specialized as the sole authorized dealer of Herman Miller in offering total solutions to the modern office in Singapore and through TRAX FURNITURE SDN BHD in Malaysia. With the intuitive knowledge of the modern working environment we provide holistic solutions that incorporate collaborations, interactions and engagements in and beyond the personal workspace.

From its humble beginnings as a modest coffee stall in the 1940s, the name of Ya Kun has become synonymous with unparalleled kaya toast and irresistibly fragrant coffee and tea, enjoyed amidst a cosy atmosphere. Today, Ya Kun continues to delight fans and to attract converts.

Yang Guo Fu is the world’s largest Mala Tang Chain known to have over 6000 franchise stores around the world, with restaurants in Japan, Korea, Canada and Singapore. They are known for their signature Spicy Mala Beef Broth, Tomato Broth and Mala dry.

store_name: Yechun Xiao Jiang Nan @ The Dining Edition
description: Yechun Xiao Jiang Nan is specialized in Jiang Nan cuisine as the name suggests, as well as Lanzhou Ramen (hand-pulled noodles). It is also the first and only Chinese restaurant that offers healthy multi-grain food in Singapore. The interior design of the restaurant is Jiang Nan style with an open kitchen, where guests could see how the Ramen and the Shanshui beancurd are made in house. Yechun Xiao Jiang Nan believes in serving guests with heartily delicious food and heartily sincere service, in the hope to bring a green and healthy dining experience to all diners.

Yi Zun Noodle is Singapore’s first ever muslim-owned restaurant that specialises in Chinese hand-pulled noodles. Founded by Madam Aisha, a Chinese-muslim from Qinghai in China, Yi Zun Noodle began as her simple dream to let fellow friends in Singapore taste authentic halal Chinese cuisine at an affordable price.

As Singapore’s leading training centre for all students, YouClass provides a wide range of academic and enrichment courses. At YouClass, every curriculum is carefully crafted to ignite students’ passion and interest in the undertaken subject.
